speaker: Patient
text: No additional symptoms were reported. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Acute appendicitis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Pancreatic Adenocarcinoma. The patient's symptoms of painless jaundice, pruritus, weight loss, pale stools, and dark urine, combined with a 72-year-old age and significant smoking history, are classic for pancreatic malignancy obstructing the common bile duct. The previous suggestion of appendicitis is clinically inconsistent with these findings, as appendicitis does not cause obstructive jaundice.
